threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think ‘the 67’ is just a bus route instead of a lifestyle choice.
Last night on the N35, a guy serenaded the driver with a ukulele. Strangely, it felt like the whole bus lifted. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I heard the spontaneous karaoke at the corner bar, mixed with the sound of late-night kebab orders. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain do you find a bar that serves beer brewed from leftover bread. It's like a cozy recycling center with fun cocktails too.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows the difference between a taco truck and a sit-down joint; you can spot the tourists waiting for overpriced sopes at Casa Oaxaca.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: I watched a guy serenade the bus stop with a ukulele, while a pigeon tried to steal his sandwich. Only in the TL, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the park and tapas, but it's the morning aroma of fresh pa amb tomàquet at every corner bakery that makes it home.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they keep apologizing for not speaking Catalan; it’s like they think we're all just waiting to judge them.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'the Tube' means a quick ride, not an exercise in standing still while the trains sit idle for hours.
Saw a lad serenading a girl with an old Nokia ringtone on the 196 last night. Never thought I’d see a 2000s phone make a comeback, let alone on a night bus.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a piece of berliner currywurst under my favorite park bench—it's like the neighborhood was welcoming me with its quirks.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find people casually debating the merits of currywurst while sipping craft beer at 9 AM in a park. It's a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they can name the burrito shop by the smell alone, even through the BART delays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 25 bus calmly juggling oranges while chatting about crypto. Only in San Francisco do you get a fruit market on wheels.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the street fiestas are planned—most just erupt spontaneously, fueled by a few tinto de verano and good vibes.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still look at the Metro map like it's a treasure map, trying to decipher the labyrinth of lines instead of just jumping on the nearest train.
